title: sig_verify functions take err: E: Fn(String)->SmimeError — could use impl Fn instead of generic
description: sig_verify.rs: verify_rsa_pkcs1, verify_ecdsa_p256, verify_ecdsa_p384 all take E: Fn(String) -> SmimeError as a generic type parameter. There is exactly one call site that creates the closure (verify.rs line 328: let e = |msg: String| SmimeError::Other(msg);), and all 8 dispatch arms use that same variable — so there is only ONE monomorphization regardless of whether the bound is generic E or impl Fn. Using impl Fn(String) -> SmimeError instead of E: Fn(String) -> SmimeError would be marginally more idiomatic Rust style (impl Fn expresses 'this is a closure argument', not 'this function is generic over a type') but has no code-size impact here. Low priority.
